sources.title: Operation order 07-26
sources.text: OPORD 07-26 (TASK FORCE SABER). 1. SITUATION: Varanian 41st Combined Arms Brigade (41st CAB) holds the Kestrel Valley west and east of the Seren River and threatens friendly movement on Route IRON. 2. MISSION: TF SABER defeats the 41st CAB's ability to interdict Route IRON in order to set conditions for the division's movement east. 3.a COMMANDER'S INTENT: Neutralize the enemy's air defense and long-range fires first, disrupt his command and control, and prevent his forces west of the Seren River from reinforcing. 3.b(1) OBJ-1: Suppress or neutralize enemy air defense in the Kestrel Valley to enable friendly aviation. 3.b(2) OBJ-2: Disrupt command and control of the 41st CAB. 3.b(3) OBJ-3: Isolate enemy forces west of the Seren River by denying Seren River crossing sites, including bridges SR-B1 and SR-B2. 3.b(4) OBJ-4: Degrade enemy long-range rocket fires and the sustainment that supports them. 3.c TARGETING GUIDANCE: High-payoff target categories are air defense radars and launchers, command posts, long-range rocket systems and their fuel and ammunition supply, and Seren River crossing sites. 3.d TARGET SELECTION STANDARDS: Location information must be no older than 4 hours for mobile targets, 24 hours for semi-fixed targets, and 72 hours for fixed targets at the time of review. Nominations require at least two independent sources, at least one rated B2 or better. 3.e RESTRICTIONS: No-Strike List version 3 (9 Oct 2026) and Restricted Target List version 2 (11 Oct 2026) are in effect. Any nomination within 500 meters of a no-strike entity requires specialist collateral damage review before it goes to the targeting board. Law of war and ROE determinations are made by the commander with Staff Judge Advocate advice.
